name: @map-harness/spatial-perf
description: Spatial performance capacity and benchmark gates: the versioned `spatial-perf@2` contract freezes seeded workloads and pinned digests, measures a map-independent compute-mix calibration probe, evaluates three same-run throughput ratios plus seven absolute gates, and retains historical absolute throughput as advisory trend data. The package also enforces bounded labels and cumulative pre-commit budgets, with stable reports and diagnostic baseline comparison. A pure library consumed by its own gate lane and diagnostic command — no host row.
